Context: 1. T.A. and Joining Time

- (d) Joining time while proceeding on I returning from leave. Government servants proceeding on leave from the place of posting in the Region to a place outside the Region are entitled for the joining time as foJlows:-
- (a) If the place of posting in the Region is not a remote locality.-
- (i) When the journey time between the place of posting and the place outside the Region is 2 days or less.
- (ii) When the journey time referred to in (i) above is more than 2 days.  
No joining time is admissible.
